consent.title: Analytics cookies
consent.body: We use Google Analytics to understand which sections of this case file get traffic, and from where. No advertising or marketing cookies. Your choice is remembered on this device.

privacy.title: Privacy & cookies
privacy.lead: This page describes what data the case file collects, why, and how to opt out.
privacy.what_p1: If you accept analytics, Google Analytics 4 records aggregated, anonymised usage data: which pages you visit, time on page, approximate country, device class. We pass anonymize_ip=true to Google so your IP is truncated before storage.
privacy.what_p2: If you decline, no analytics cookies are written. Consent Mode v2 keeps Google's scripts loaded but holds them in a denied state — nothing is reported to Google's servers.
privacy.no_p1: No advertising, marketing, or personalisation cookies. No third-party trackers beyond Google Analytics. No cross-site profiling.
privacy.user_p1: If you create an account to submit a reader story, we store your email, username, optional display name, and your submission. This data is held in our own database, never sold or shared. You can request deletion any time by contacting the editor.
privacy.change_p1: Clear this site's data in your browser to see the consent banner again. Or contact the editor.
